matches.reason: Aquacolor is a glycerin-based compact make-up, especially color-intensive, with the ingredients of superior-quality skin cream preparations. Introducing the Studio Color - Carnival Studio, the ultimate makeup palette for endless creativity. With 8 refillable colors, this versatile studio is perfect for on-the-go touch-ups or bold looks. Unleash your inner artist with the Carnival Studio. The Carnival Creme Palette contains a spectrum of vivid creme colors for creating beautiful and creative works of all kinds. Each shade is vibrant and intensely pigmented to give you total control in achieving your makeup design. The colors easily blend together to create new shades or exquisite contours. With all aspects of the color wheel in one convenient palette, artists and students of all skill levels are able to explore their full creative potential. This palette is ideal for theatrical, fashion, drag, Halloween enthusiasts, students, and cosplay makeup artists. Expect 20-50 application Eight vivid creme colors. This is makeup, not a printed garment. Brushes and setting products are not included in the stated contents.
